summary.text: Douglas Campbell, a Green Party candidate who ran with Bobbie Clay as running mate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for governor of Michigan to Jocelyn Benson, receiving 0.4% of the vote to Benson's 54.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
